summary_short.zh: Gallery 是一个开源 Android 应用，专门展示在设备端运行的机器学习和生成式 AI 的实际用例，让用户无需依赖云端即可本地体验模型。它通过集成 TensorFlow Lite 和 MediaPipe 等框架，演示了如何将复杂 AI 模型优化部署到移动设备，体现了边缘计算的高效性。开发者可以研究其代码学习实现模式，借鉴展示的用例开发自己的应用，或将其作为测试平台，直接在 Android 设备上评估端侧 AI 模型的性能与用户体验。

summaries.en: Gallery is an open-source Android application that demonstrates practical on-device machine learning and generative AI implementations, enabling users to experience models locally without cloud dependency. Its technical insight lies in showcasing optimized model deployment through TensorFlow Lite and MediaPipe, illustrating how complex AI can run efficiently on mobile hardware. Developers can explore the codebase to learn implementation patterns, adapt the showcased use cases for their own projects, or use it as a testing platform for evaluating on-device AI performance directly on Android devices.

summary_short.zh: LiteRT-LM是一个专为边缘计算设计的开源推理引擎，能够在手机、物联网设备等资源受限的硬件上高效运行大语言模型。其核心技术在于针对边缘场景优化的计算内核和内存管理机制，通过算子融合和量化策略在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算开销。开发者可将其集成到移动应用或嵌入式系统中，实现无需云端依赖的本地AI功能，特别适用于隐私保护要求高或需要实时响应的场景，如离线语音助手、智能摄像头分析等。

summaries.en: LiteRT-LM is an open-source inference engine designed to efficiently run large language models on resource-constrained edge devices like smartphones and IoT hardware. It achieves this through specialized kernel optimizations and memory management techniques that reduce computational overhead while maintaining model accuracy. Developers can integrate it into mobile applications or embedded systems to enable on-device AI capabilities without cloud dependency, making it ideal for privacy-sensitive or latency-critical use cases.
